title: Einsum optimizer module
objective: Implement contraction planning with budget counting, tier classification, and JIT budget guardrails.
implementation_steps: Implement tier classification: Tier 1 (library @ti.func), Tier 2 (generated @ti.func), Tier 3 (fallback)
Implement budget counter: count unrolled lines per @ti.func (max 512) and per @ti.kernel (max 2000)
Implement guardrails: abort if absolute ceiling (5000) exceeded
Use opt_einsum for contraction path optimization
Write unit tests with expected tier assignments and over-budget failures
acceptance_criteria: Tier classification matches expected assignments for MVP contractions
Over-budget contractions trigger failure with restructuring suggestion
risks: opt_einsum may produce unexpected contraction orders — verify with known examples
Budget counting accuracy depends on correct line estimation
